mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, primary_customer_id, secondary_customer_id, status, match_evidence, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at, version
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_merge_case WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('SUGGESTED','REVIEWING') AND ((primary_customer_id = #{customerA} AND secondary_customer_id = #{customerB}) OR (primary_customer_id = #{customerB} AND secondary_customer_id = #{customerA}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_merge_case (tenant_id, primary_customer_id, secondary_customer_id, status, match_evidence) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{primaryCustomerId}, #{secondaryCustomerId}, #{status}, #{matchEvidence})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_merge_case SET status = #{toStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND ((status IN ('SUGGESTED','REVIEWING') AND #{toStatus} IN ('REVIEWING','CONFIRMED','REJECTED')) OR (status = 'CONFIRMED' AND #{toStatus} = 'REVERSED'))
mapper.select:

ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
